n: Estimates assume a K.K. with capital ≤ ¥10M and the director as the only insured executive. Health-insurance rates are Kyokai Kenpo FY2026 by prefecture (+0.23% child-support levy, LTC 1.62%). Standard-remuneration grades and rounding are simplified.
Director's bonus assumes a filed pre-notification and payment exactly as notified; otherwise non-deductible. Bonus SI caps: health ¥5.73M/yr, pension ¥1.5M per payment (once a year assumed).

Employer cost for staff ≈ half of health/LTC/support levy + half of pension + 0.36% child levy + 0.9% employment ins. + 0.3% workers' comp (≈16–17% of pay). Employee-withheld shares are not an employer cost.
SME Mutual Aid premiums (¥1,000–70,000/mo) are fully deductible from personal income and paid out on retirement or closure as retirement income.
Enterprise tax is treated as deductible in the same year (iterative approximation). Consumption tax uses tax-exclusive accounting (shown separately from the bar).
With base-period taxable sales over ¥50M the simplified scheme is unavailable (over ¥10M: no exemption / 20% rule) — the standard method applies.

Inhabitant and enterprise taxes use standard rates; surtax municipalities (Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya, etc.) may be slightly higher. Per-capita levy: ¥70,000. Deductions follow the FY2025 tax reform (applied to 2026).
